title: Robot waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8fd6ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4fa8e0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='screenGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#1a2a4a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0d1630'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Antenna -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='50' y2='9' stroke='#c0d8f0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='6' r='1.3' fill='#fffbe0'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <rect x='26' y='18' width='48' height='38' rx='10' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='26' y='18' width='48' height='38' rx='10' fill='none' stroke='#c8e8ff' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Ear pieces -->
  <rect x='21' y='30' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#3a7fb0'/>
  <rect x='73' y='30' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#3a7fb0'/>

  <!-- LED screen -->
  <rect x='32' y='24' width='36' height='26' rx='6' fill='url(#screenGrad)'/>

  <!-- Happy eyes (glow) -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='34' r='3.4' fill='#7dffb0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='34' r='3.4' fill='#7dffb0'/>
  <circle cx='42.2' cy='32.8' r='1.2' fill='#e0ffef'/>

  <!-- Smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M43 42 Q50 47 57 42' stroke='#7dffb0' stroke-width='2.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='56' width='12' height='6' rx='2' fill='#3a7fb0'/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <rect x='32' y='62' width='36' height='30' rx='8' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='32' y='62' width='36' height='30' rx='8' fill='none' stroke='#c8e8ff' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- Chest button -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='4' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='1.6' fill='#fffbe0'/>

  <!-- Chest light strip -->
  <rect x='43' y='81' width='14' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7dffb0'/>

  <!-- Left arm (down, resting) -->
  <rect x='24' y='66' width='7' height='20' rx='3.5' fill='#3a7fb0'/>
  <circle cx='27.5' cy='88' r='4.5' fill='#8fd6ff'/>

  <!-- Right arm (raised, waving) -->
  <rect x='69' y='50' width='7' height='20' rx='3.5' fill='#3a7fb0' transform='rotate(25 72.5 60)'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='48' r='5' fill='#8fd6ff'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='46.5' r='1.6' fill='#dff2ff'/>

  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='40' y='92' width='8' height='7' rx='3' fill='#3a7fb0'/>
  <rect x='52' y='92' width='8' height='7' rx='3' fill='#3a7fb0'/>
</svg>
